content.title: Tomahawk Metals chair: Slovakia and Australia assets set stage for AIM listing
content.description:
Tomahawk Metals Plc (AQSE:TMHK) executive chairman Rolf Gerritsen spoke with Proactive's Stephen Gunnio about the company's gold and antimony assets in Slovakia and Australia, recent exploration results from its Saturn licence, and plans to seek admission to AIM.

Gerritsen explained that Tomahawk Metals is a relatively new natural resources business following its pivot from Shortwave Life Sciences, having taken on antimony and gold assets in Slovakia alongside the Saturn gold licence in the Southern Cross area of Western Australia.

In Slovakia, Gerritsen highlighted the region's mining history and opportunities tied to European critical minerals initiatives. Tomahawk now has three licences transferred into its Slovakian subsidiary, with another two under application, and is eyeing potential European Community grants to support exploration and development.

In Australia, attention is focused on Saturn, where Tomahawk recently reported a rock-chip result of up to 44.85 grams per tonne gold following a site visit that identified historical workings and exploration digs. "There are a number of clearly identifiable areas to explore further," Gerritsen said, with the next work programme being defined and potentially leading to trenching and drill target identification.

Gerritsen also discussed Tomahawk's proposed AIM listing, with admission documents in preparation and completion of the Competent Person's Report for the Slovakian asset a critical step. The company is aiming to complete the admission document, and ideally the listing itself, by year-end, subject to market conditions and necessary approvals.

content.title: Sunda Energy, Meridian Mining, Quantum Helium, Light Science Technologies, Foresight Solar, hVIVO
content.description:
Sunda Energy PLC (AIM:SNDA, FRA:GHA0) has raised £5.25 million to fund completion of its New Zealand acquisition. It's also launching a retail offer for a further £525,000.

Meridian Mining Plc (LSE:MNO, TSX:MNO, OTCQX:MRRDF) has delivered a net present value of $2.09 billion for its Cabaçal project in Brazil. The CEO says the economics could make it the next major near-term gold-copper mine.

Quantum Helium Ltd (AIM:QHE) is targeting Q4 2026 for a larger fracture stimulation programme at Sagebrush-1 in Colorado. It's also taking a 9% stake in Herencia Resources.

Light Science Technologies Holdings PLC (AIM:LST, FRA:9FD) has secured a repeat order from a healthcare devices customer, pushing that contract past £500,000. It's building out higher-margin work in defence and medical sectors.

Foresight Solar Fund Ltd (LSE:FSFL, FRA:1F5) says it's considering all strategic options to lift a share price stuck below the value of its assets. The board says it needs to "act decisively" to close that gap.

hVIVO PLC (AIM:HVO) has appointed Caroline Shaw as an independent non-executive director. She brings more than 30 years of senior healthcare leadership to the board.
